name: Bank of America® Travel Rewards Credit Card

localized_names.en: Bank of America® Travel Rewards Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 15 billing cycles for purchases and qualifying balance transfers; then a variable APR applies.

base_rate.description: 1.5 points for every $1 spent on all purchases

categories.label: Travel purchases booked through the Bank of America Travel Center

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed for statement credits toward travel and dining purchases; points do not expire as long as the account remains open.

signup_bonus.description: 25,000 online bonus points after at least $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: $0 Liability Guarantee
benefits.description: Bank of America provides a $0 Liability Guarantee for fraudulent transactions.

benefits.title: Balance Connect for overdraft protection
benefits.description: Optional overdraft-protection service when linked to an eligible Bank of America checking account; other fees may apply.

benefits.title: Digital wallet support
benefits.description: Card can be added to supported mobile wallets including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay.

notes: Credit score requirements and non-listed travel perks were not stated in the official Bank of America sources.
